visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: A Decorator Instead of Counting by Hand in Every Function
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Each function increments a global counter itself. Write a count_calls decorator that counts the calls of any function it wraps. The output must stay the same.
visualizerParams.initialCode:
calls = 0


def greet(name):
    global calls
    calls += 1
    return "Hello, " + name


def shout(name):
    global calls
    calls += 1
    return name.upper() + "!"


print(greet("Asha"))
print(shout("ravi"))
print(calls)

solution.explanation: The counting is written once and applied with one line (@count_calls), the functions contain only their own job, and there is no global variable to share.
